name: Strah i gormony v drevnih ruinah
original_name: Страх и гормоны в древних руинах
source:
Three students, some ancient ruins, and an apology note in place of a mentor. This is the perfect way to start practice for the charming cat-girl Rina, the lovely quiet dryad Olivia, and the very indecisive protagonist, who has decided at the academy that the end of practice will also be the end of this lonely life! And just to be sure - he bought a few potions of courage from the Witch. The most reliable plan - if you have courage, the words will find themselves, and maybe something else interesting will happen...

[translated from [url=https://ellayasan.itch.io/fear-and-hormones-in-ancient-ruins]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个学生，一处古代遗迹，还有一张代替导师到场的道歉便条。对迷人的猫娘莉娜、可爱而安静的树精奥莉维娅，以及优柔寡断的主人公来说，这简直是实习的完美开端。主人公早在学院里就已决定：实习结束之日，也要终结孤单生活！为了保险，他还向女巫买了几瓶勇气药水。再可靠不过的计划：只要有勇气，话自然就说得出来，也许，还会发生点别的有趣事情…

[译自[url=https://ellayasan.itch.io/fear-and-hormones-in-ancient-ruins]itch.io[/url]]
